  %\VignetteIndexEntry{Creating ASUs with ASUbuildR}

```{r dashboard-guide, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
guide_path <- file.path("..", "inst", "shiny_app", "dashboard-guide.md")
if (!file.exists(guide_path)) {
  guide_path <- system.file("shiny_app", "dashboard-guide.md", package = "ASUbuildR")
}
if (!nzchar(guide_path) || !file.exists(guide_path)) {
  stop("Dashboard user guide is missing.")
}
cat(readLines(guide_path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), sep = "\n")
```
